execution_modules.label: Pen activity / energy
execution_modules.notice: Decoded a uniform cap of 120 frames and localized 1090 individual-sized bird observations; classified 219 bounded crops with behaviour-v1/chicken-yolo11n-640+behaviour7-yolo11n-cls-224. Overlapping multi-scale tiles improve small-bird recall. Group-sized regions are rejected before behavior inference. The score combines frame-to-frame pixel motion with aggregate single-frame behavior evidence; it is not individual tracking.

execution_modules.label: Flock appearance
execution_modules.notice: Synthetic deterministic adapter; no model artifact was executed.

execution_modules.label: Feces candidate detection
execution_modules.notice: Ran dropping4-pen/dropping4pen-yolo11n-640 on 120 real decoded frames and retained 6 candidate crop(s). Field accuracy is not established.

execution_modules.label: Feces appearance classification
execution_modules.notice: Live YOLO11n ONNX ran on 6 crop(s) cut from real sampled video frames. Results remain non-diagnostic and field accuracy is not established.
